evidence: SW4 show vlan brief indicates VLAN 50 Engineering is active on Fa0/10-12.
SW4 running-config for interface Fa0/13 shows switchport mode access and switchport access vlan 1.
PC7 is connected to Fa0/13 and cannot communicate with peers in its intended VLAN 50.
root_cause: PC7's switch access port Fa0/13 on SW4 is assigned to default VLAN 1 instead of the intended VLAN 50.
verification: Run 'show vlan brief' on SW4 and confirm interface Fa0/13 is assigned to VLAN 50.
Test connectivity from PC7 to peers in VLAN 50.
fix_steps: Access SW4 and enter global configuration mode.
Navigate to interface Fa0/13 configuration mode.
Reassign switch port Fa0/13 to access VLAN 50 using the command 'switchport access vlan 50'.
Save the running configuration to startup configuration.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: Switch port Fa0/13 is assigned to default VLAN 1 instead of access VLAN 50.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Reassign switch port Fa0/13 to access VLAN 50.
